verdict.rationale: Okta documents a SCIM-based provisioning integration in which Okta manages user lifecycle in connected apps, and SCIM supports CRUD on user resources, which implies deprovisioning is possible. Nothing in the evidence shows that deactivating a user is a single action that kills active sessions and immediately deprovisions accounts across all connected apps. Missing for 10: documented deactivation-triggered deprovisioning across apps, session revocation on deactivation, immediacy/timing guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, offboarding is one action — deactivating a user kills their sessions and deprovisions their accounts across connected apps immediately

citations.quote: build an Okta integration that uses the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) protocol to handle user provisioning
a RESTful API to run CRUD operations on those user and group resources
